component.title: Attachment preview
component.purpose: Renders an image, file or captured photo attached to a message, staying within the limits the channel descriptor declares and stating clearly when a file exceeds them.

states.description: An attachment that fits the channel's declared limits.

claims.statement: Whether an attachment is acceptable is decided by the channel descriptor's declared limits.
claims.rationale: OT-P0-002. Media limits differ per channel and belong in data, not in the preview component.

claims.statement: An attachment that exceeds a limit states the limit and the channel, before the send is attempted.
claims.rationale: Discovering a size limit from a failed send is the worst version of this interaction.

claims.statement: Every rendered attachment carries an accessible name derived from its filename or caption.

priorities.statement: Whether this channel will accept it
